history.text: Rob Van Dam beat Tommy Dreamer in a unification match, merging the Hardcore title into the Intercontinental Championship.
The title ended with its unification, and Van Dam was its final champion.
Stone Cold Steve Austin gave Mick Foley the belt for his hardcore contributions, but not the championship itself.
Edge and Foley declared themselves co-holders during an ECW-alumni storyline.
The title was not defended afterward and soon quietly disappeared.
Triple H handed Travis Scott a new belt at a concert and declared him the new WWE Hardcore Champion.
